name: Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals

fee.note: Microsoft prices by exam country/region; the exam page shows the price for your location. Students and educators can schedule through Certiport.

exam.format: Proctored 45-minute exam through Pearson VUE (Certiport for students and educators); interactive components may appear. Microsoft does not publish the question count or question types per exam.

scope: Security, compliance and identity concepts, and what Microsoft Entra, Microsoft's security solutions (Azure infrastructure security, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Defender XDR) and Microsoft Purview compliance solutions do.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Microsoft says most of its exams have 40–60 questions but does not publish the count for SC-900.
Skills measured were updated on 21 October 2026 with minor changes (Entra identity types, Defender XDR). Localized versions are updated about eight weeks after the English one.
